svg.title: Reduce, preserve, or enlarge a rectangle using scale factors
svg.desc: Three rectangles drawn at the same page scale of 14 pixels per unit. A four-by-two rectangle represents scale factor one-half relative to the original eight-by-four rectangle. The original has scale factor one, and a twelve-by-six rectangle uses scale factor three-halves. Reversing the reduction requires scale factor 2, while reversing the enlargement requires scale factor two-thirds. Side-length ratios and corresponding angles must match; diagrams are original Edulytiks models.
svg.text: The same original rectangle under three scale factors
To restore the original: multiply the reduced copy by 2 or the enlarged copy by 2/3.
